def answer():
    return [
        (0, F5, 4), (4, E5, 2), (6, D5, 2), (8, C5, 6),
        (16, D5, 4), (20, C5, 4), (24, Bb4, 8),
        (32, A4, 4), (36, G4, 4), (40, A4, 6),
        (48, F4, 4), (52, G4, 4), (56, A4, 8),
    ]

STABS_I = [
    (0, D4, A4, 30), (16, Bb3, F4, 28), (32, F3, C4, 28), (48, A3, E4, 32),
]
STABS_I_OFF = [
    (0, D4, A4, 30), (8, F4, C5, 20), (16, D4, Bb4, 28),
    (32, C4, G4, 28), (40, E4, Bb4, 18), (48, Cs4, A4, 32),
]

def make_patterns():
    P = []

    # 00 intro: wide pad, sparse bells, no clutter
    p = Pat(); p.pan()
    pad(p, [(0, D3, A3), (16, Bb3, F4), (32, F3, C4), (48, A3, Cs4)], vol=24)
    for row, m in [(0, D5), (8, A4), (16, F5), (24, D5), (32, C5), (40, A4), (48, E5), (56, Cs5)]:
        p.n(6, row, m, BELL, vol=28)
    p.n(7, 32, A4, LEAD2, vol=26)
    p.n(7, 48, E5, LEAD2, vol=24)
    p.off(7, 60)
    P.append(p)

    # 01 bass + half drums + arp
    p = Pat(); p.pan()
    pad(p, [(0, D3, A3), (16, Bb3, F4), (32, F3, C4), (48, A3, E4)], vol=20)
    drums(p, "half", kv=40, sv=28, hv=14)
    bassline(p, bass_half())
    arpeggio(p, cat(DM, BB, FF, AA), step=2, vol=24, inst=ARP)
    P.append(p)

    # 02 groove established, stabs, lead teases the hook's first bar
    p = Pat(); p.pan()
    drums(p, "main", kv=46, sv=36, hv=16)
    bassline(p, bass_i_VI_III_V(44))
    arpeggio(p, cat(DM, BB, FF, AA), step=2, vol=24, inst=ARP)
    chord_stabs(p, STABS_I)
    melody(p, [(48, A4, 4), (52, D5, 4), (56, C5, 4), (60, A4, 4)], vol=34)
    P.append(p)

    # 03 answer phrase, syncopated drums
    p = Pat(); p.pan()
    drums(p, "sync", kv=46, sv=36, hv=16)
    bassline(p, bass_i_VI_III_V(44))
    arpeggio(p, cat(DM, BB, CC, AM), step=2, vol=22, inst=ARP)
    chord_stabs(p, [(0, F4, C5, 26), (16, D4, Bb4, 28), (32, C4, G4, 26), (48, E4, C5, 28)])
    melody(p, answer(), vol=38, inst=LEAD)
    P.append(p)

    # 04 THE HOOK
    p = Pat(); p.pan()
    drums(p, "hook", kv=48, sv=38, hv=16)
    bassline(p, bass_16ths(46))
    arpeggio(p, cat([x + 12 for x in DM], [x + 12 for x in BB], FF, AA), step=2, vol=20, inst=BELL)
    chord_stabs(p, STABS_I_OFF)
    melody(p, hook_a(), vol=42, inst=LEAD)
    P.append(p)

    # 05 hook answer
    p = Pat(); p.pan()
    drums(p, "hook", kv=48, sv=40, hv=16)
    bassline(p, bass_16ths(46))
    arpeggio(p, cat(DM, BB, GM, AA), step=2, vol=22, inst=ARP)
    chord_stabs(p, [(0, F4, D5, 26), (16, Bb3, F4, 28), (32, G3, D4, 28), (48, A3, E4, 32)])
    melody(p, hook_b(), vol=42, inst=LEAD)
    P.append(p)

    # 06 breakdown — space, pad, long lead, bells
    p = Pat(); p.pan()
    pad(p, [(0, D3, A3), (16, Bb3, F4), (32, C4, G4), (48, A3, E4)], vol=26)
    drums(p, "half", kv=34, sv=24, hv=12)
    bassline(p, bass_half())
    for row, m in [(0, D5), (6, F5), (12, A4), (16, Bb4), (24, D5), (32, E5), (40, C5), (48, Cs5), (56, E5)]:
        p.n(6, row, m, BELL, vol=32)
    melody(p, [(0, A4, 16), (16, Bb4, 14), (32, G4, 16), (48, A4, 16)], vol=32, inst=LEAD2)
    P.append(p)

    # 07 hook with harmony (ch6 soft lead, no arp)
    p = Pat(); p.pan()
    drums(p, "drive", kv=48, sv=40, hv=16)
    bassline(p, bass_16ths(48))
    chord_stabs(p, STABS_I)
    melody(p, hook_harmony(), vol=28, inst=LEAD2, ch=6)
    melody(p, hook_a(), vol=44, inst=LEAD, ch=7)
    P.append(p)

    # 08 ornament
    p = Pat(); p.pan()
    drums(p, "drive", kv=48, sv=40, hv=15)
    bassline(p, bass_16ths(46))
    arpeggio(p, cat(DM, BB, FF, AA), step=2, vol=22, inst=ARP)
    chord_stabs(p, STABS_I_OFF)
    melody(p, hook_orn(), vol=42, inst=LEAD)
    P.append(p)

    # 09 bridge Gm -> A
    p = Pat(); p.pan()
    drums(p, "main", kv=46, sv=36, hv=16)
    bassline(p, bass_bridge())
    arpeggio(p, cat(GM, BB, FF, AA), step=2, vol=24, inst=ARP)
    chord_stabs(p, [(0, G3, D4, 28), (16, Bb3, F4, 28), (32, F3, C4, 26), (48, Cs4, A4, 32)])
    melody(p, [
        (0, G4, 4), (4, Bb4, 4), (8, D5, 6), (16, C5, 4), (20, Bb4, 4), (24, A4, 8),
        (32, A4, 4), (36, C5, 4), (40, E5, 6), (48, D5, 4), (52, C5, 4), (56, Bb4, 4), (60, A4, 4),
    ], vol=40, inst=LEAD2)
    P.append(p)

    # 10 peak: harmony + hook B + brighter stabs
    p = Pat(); p.pan()
    drums(p, "drive", kv=50, sv=40, hv=15)
    bassline(p, bass_16ths(48))
    chord_stabs(p, [(0, D4, A4, 32), (8, F4, C5, 20), (16, D4, Bb4, 30),
                    (32, E4, C5, 30), (48, Cs4, A4, 34)])
    melody(p, hook_harmony(), vol=26, inst=LEAD2, ch=6)
    melody(p, hook_b(), vol=44, inst=LEAD, ch=7)
    P.append(p)

    # 11 fill / climb
    p = Pat(); p.pan()
    drums(p, "break", kv=46, sv=38, hv=14)
    bassline(p, bass_bridge())
    arpeggio(p, cat([x + 12 for x in GM], [x + 12 for x in BB], AA, AA), step=2, vol=24, inst=BELL)
    chord_stabs(p, [(0, G3, D4, 28), (16, Bb3, F4, 28), (32, Cs4, A4, 32), (48, E4, Cs5, 30)])
    melody(p, hook_orn(), vol=40, inst=LEAD)
    p.n(2, 60, C5, FX, vol=20)
    P.append(p)

    # 12 drop
    p = Pat(); p.pan()
    pad(p, [(0, D3, A3), (16, Bb3, F4), (32, F3, C4), (48, A3, E4)], vol=26)
    for r, v in ((0, 42), (16, 36), (32, 40), (48, 44)):
        p.n(0, r, C3, KICK, vol=v)
    p.n(1, 8, D4, SNARE, vol=22)
    p.n(1, 40, D4, SNARE, vol=20)
    for r in range(0, 64, 8):
        p.n(2, r, C5, HAT, vol=12)
    bassline(p, bass_half())
    for row, m in ((0, D5), (8, A5), (16, F5), (24, D5), (32, C5), (40, A4), (48, E5), (56, Cs5)):
        p.n(6, row, m, BELL, vol=30)
    melody(p, [(0, D5, 16), (16, F5, 14), (32, C5, 16), (48, E5, 8), (56, D5, 8)], vol=36, inst=LEAD)
    P.append(p)

    # 13 return hook
    p = Pat(); p.pan()
    drums(p, "hook", kv=48, sv=38, hv=16)
    bassline(p, bass_i_VI_III_V(46))
    arpeggio(p, cat(DM, BB, FF, AA), step=2, vol=24, inst=ARP)
    chord_stabs(p, STABS_I)
    melody(p, hook_a(), vol=42, inst=LEAD)
    P.append(p)

    # 14 final hook + harmony
    p = Pat(); p.pan()
    drums(p, "drive", kv=50, sv=40, hv=15)
    bassline(p, bass_16ths(48))
    chord_stabs(p, STABS_I)
    melody(p, hook_harmony(), vol=28, inst=LEAD2, ch=6)
    melody(p, hook_a(), vol=46, inst=LEAD, ch=7)
    P.append(p)

    # 15 outro: cadence to A, then cut so intro's Dm resolves the loop
    p = Pat(); p.pan()
    drums(p, "half", kv=30, sv=20, hv=12)
    for r in range(0, 32, 4):
        p.n(2, r, C5, HAT, vol=max(8, 14 - r // 8))
    bassline(p, [(0, D2, 38), (16, F2, 32), (24, E2, 30), (32, D2, 34), (48, A2, 36)])
    pad(p, [(0, D3, A3), (16, F3, C4), (32, D3, A3), (48, A3, E4)], vol=20)
    melody(p, [(0, A4, 8), (8, G4, 8), (16, F4, 8), (24, E4, 8), (32, D4, 14)], vol=30, inst=LEAD2)
    p.n(6, 0, A4, BELL, vol=26)
    p.n(6, 32, D5, BELL, vol=24)
    p.n(6, 48, E5, BELL, vol=22)
    p.n(6, 56, Cs5, BELL, vol=20)
    # release before the seam
    p.off(7, 48)
    p.off(4, 62)
    p.off(5, 62)
    p.off(3, 62)
    P.append(p)

    for p in P:
        merge_cells(p)
        ensure_pan(p)
        merge_cells(p)
    return P

def build():
    samples = [
        (1, kick(), "kick", False, 64, "Kick"),
        (2, snare(), "snare", False, 52, "Snare"),
        (3, hat(False), "hat", False, 36, "Hat"),
        (4, hat(True), "ohat", False, 34, "HatOpen"),
        (5, bass_loop(), "bass", True, 60, "Bass"),
        (6, lead_loop(), "lead", True, 48, "Lead"),
        (7, lead_soft_loop(), "lead2", True, 42, "LeadSoft"),
        (8, pad_loop(), "pad", True, 40, "Pad"),
        (9, bell(), "bell", False, 44, "Bell"),
        (10, stab(), "stab", False, 44, "Stab"),
        (11, arp(), "arp", False, 42, "Arp"),
        (12, sweep(), "fx", False, 32, "Sweep"),
    ]
    pats = make_patterns()
    print("patterns", len(pats))
    for i, p in enumerate(pats):
        print(f"  {i:02d} {len(p.cells)} cells")

    calls = [{
        "name": "module_new",
        "arguments": {"channels": 8, "name": "Serial Velocity"},
    }, {
        "name": "song_set",
        "arguments": {
            "name": "Serial Velocity", "bpm": 136, "speed": 5,
            "length": len(pats), "loop_start": 0, "channels": 8,
        },
    }]
    for inst, pcm, sname, loop, vol, iname in samples:
        calls.append({"name": "sample_create_from_pcm", "arguments": {
            "instrument": inst, "sample": 0, "pcm": b64(pcm),
            "encoding": "float32", "name": sname,
        }})
        calls.append({"name": "instrument_set", "arguments": {"instrument": inst, "name": iname}})
        args = {"instrument": inst, "sample": 0, "name": sname,
                "volume": vol, "panning": 128, "finetune": 0, "relative_note": 0}
        if loop:
            args.update(flags=1, loop_start=0, loop_length=int(len(pcm)))
        calls.append({"name": "sample_set", "arguments": args})
        print(f"smp {inst} {iname:8s} {len(pcm)}")

    for i, p in enumerate(pats):
        calls.append({"name": "pattern_set_length", "arguments": {"pattern": i, "rows": 64}})
        calls.append({"name": "order_set", "arguments": {"position": i, "pattern": i}})
        for c in p.cells:
            a = {"pattern": i, "row": c["row"], "channel": c["channel"]}
            if c["note"] is not None:
                a["note"] = c["note"]
            if c["instrument"]:
                a["instrument"] = c["instrument"]
            if c["volume"] is not None:
                a["volume"] = int(c["volume"])
            if c["effect"]:
                a["effect"] = int(c["effect"])
                a["effect_param"] = int(c["effect_param"])
            calls.append({"name": "pattern_set_cell", "arguments": a})

    calls.append({"name": "module_save", "arguments": {
        "path": "/workspace/submission/tune.xm", "format": "xm"}})
    calls.append({"name": "module_render", "arguments": {
        "path": "/tmp/tune_preview.wav", "rate": 22050, "bits": 16, "loops": 1}})
    with open(OUT, "w") as f:
        json.dump(calls, f)
    print("calls", len(calls), "bytes", os.path.getsize(OUT))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    build()

    s=int(i*pat_s*sr); e=int(min(len(d), (i+1)*pat_s*sr))
    ch=d[s:e]
    rms=np.sqrt(np.mean(ch**2)); pk=np.max(np.abs(ch))
    mid=ch.mean(1); side=(ch[:,0]-ch[:,1])/2
    width=np.sqrt(np.mean(side**2))/(np.sqrt(np.mean(mid**2))+1e-9)
    corr=np.corrcoef(ch[:,0], ch[:,1])[0,1]

import wave, numpy as np
w=wave.open("/tmp/tune_preview.wav")
d=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype=np.int16).reshape(-1,2).astype(np.float32)
sr=w.getframerate()
mono=d.mean(1)
row_s=5*2.5/136
pat_s=64*row_s
print("dur", round(len(d)/sr,2), "peak", np.max(np.abs(d)))
print("--- levels / stereo ---")
for i in range(16):
    s=int(i*pat_s*sr); e=int(min(len(d),(i+1)*pat_s*sr))
    ch=d[s:e]
    rms=np.sqrt(np.mean(ch**2)); pk=np.max(np.abs(ch))
    side=(ch[:,0]-ch[:,1])/2; mid=ch.mean(1)
    width=np.sqrt(np.mean(side**2))/(np.sqrt(np.mean(mid**2))+1e-9)
    corr=np.corrcoef(ch[:,0],ch[:,1])[0,1]
    print(f"p{i:02d} rms {rms:6.0f} pk {pk:6.0f} width {width:.2f} corr {corr:.3f}")

def bands(i):
    s=int(i*pat_s*sr); e=int((i+1)*pat_s*sr)
    ch=mono[s:e]
    spec=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(ch))
    freqs=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(ch),1/sr)
    def b(a,c): return spec[(freqs>=a)&(freqs<c)].sum()
    parts=[b(30,90),b(90,220),b(220,2000),b(2000,9000)]
    t=sum(parts)+1
    return [x/t for x in parts]
print("--- sub bass mid high ---")
for i in [0,1,2,4,6,7,12,15]:
    print(f"p{i:02d}", " ".join(f"{x:.2f}" for x in bands(i)))

# check pan actually moved: energy on far L vs R in intro (pads hard panned)
s=int(0.4*sr); e=int(1.2*sr)
print("intro L/R rms", np.sqrt(np.mean(d[s:e,0]**2)), np.sqrt(np.mean(d[s:e,1]**2)))
# pattern 4 start: stab should be hard L and hard R
t=4*pat_s+0.02
s=int(t*sr); e=int((t+0.12)*sr)
print("p4 attack L/R", np.sqrt(np.mean(d[s:e,0]**2)), np.sqrt(np.mean(d[s:e,1]**2)))

def peaks(t0, dur, fmax):
    seg=mono[int(t0*sr):int((t0+dur)*sr)]
    seg=(seg-seg.mean())*np.hanning(len(seg))
    spec=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg)); freqs=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(seg),1/sr)
    spec[freqs>fmax]=0; spec[:2]=0
    idx=np.argsort(spec)[-4:][::-1]
    return [(round(float(freqs[i]),1)) for i in idx]
print("intro peaks", peaks(0.3,0.8,900))
print("bass D2", peaks(2*pat_s+0.1, 0.25, 300))
print("lead A4", peaks(4*pat_s+0.08, 0.22, 1500))
print("lead D5", peaks(4*pat_s+4*row_s+0.06, 0.22, 1600))
# seam
print("start rms 0.1s", np.sqrt(np.mean(mono[:int(0.1*sr)]**2)))
print("end rms 0.15s", np.sqrt(np.mean(mono[-int(0.15*sr):]**2)))
print("clips>30k", int(np.sum(np.max(np.abs(d),1)>30000)))

import wave, numpy as np
w=wave.open("/tmp/tune_preview.wav")
d=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype=np.int16).reshape(-1,2).astype(np.float32)
sr=w.getframerate(); mono=d.mean(1)
row_s=5*2.5/136; pat_s=64*row_s
print("peak", np.max(np.abs(d)), "dur", round(len(d)/sr,1))
for i in range(16):
    s=int(i*pat_s*sr); e=int(min(len(d),(i+1)*pat_s*sr))
    ch=d[s:e]
    rms=np.sqrt(np.mean(ch**2)); pk=np.max(np.abs(ch))
    side=(ch[:,0]-ch[:,1])/2; mid=ch.mean(1)
    width=np.sqrt(np.mean(side**2))/(np.sqrt(np.mean(mid**2))+1e-9)
    corr=np.corrcoef(ch[:,0],ch[:,1])[0,1]
    print(f"p{i:02d} rms {rms:6.0f} pk {pk:6.0f} width {width:.2f} corr {corr:.3f}")
# stereo moments
def lr(t, dur):
    s=int(t*sr); e=int((t+dur)*sr)
    return round(float(np.sqrt(np.mean(d[s:e,0]**2)))), round(float(np.sqrt(np.mean(d[s:e,1]**2))))
print("intro pad window", lr(0.15, 0.4))
print("p4 stab attack", lr(4*pat_s+0.02, 0.15))
print("p2 stab attack", lr(2*pat_s+0.02, 0.15))
print("p6 pad", lr(6*pat_s+0.2, 0.5))
print("clips", int(np.sum(np.max(np.abs(d),1)>30000)))
# bands
def bands(i):
    s=int(i*pat_s*sr); e=int((i+1)*pat_s*sr)
    ch=mono[s:e]
    spec=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(ch)); freqs=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(ch),1/sr)
    def b(a,c): return spec[(freqs>=a)&(freqs<c)].sum()
    parts=[b(30,90),b(90,250),b(250,2200),b(2200,9000)]
    t=sum(parts)+1
    return [round(x/t,2) for x in parts]
print("bands sub/low/mid/hi", {i: bands(i) for i in [0,2,4,7,12]})

import wave, numpy as np
w=wave.open("/tmp/tune_preview.wav")
d=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype=np.int16).reshape(-1,2).astype(np.float32)
sr=w.getframerate(); mono=d.mean(1)
row_s=5*2.5/136; pat_s=64*row_s

def spectrum_peaks(t0, dur, fmax=4000, n=8):
    seg=mono[int(t0*sr):int((t0+dur)*sr)]
    seg=(seg-seg.mean())*np.hanning(len(seg))
    spec=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg)); freqs=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(seg),1/sr)
    spec[freqs>fmax]=0
    idx=np.argsort(spec)[-n:][::-1]
    return [(round(float(freqs[i]),1), int(spec[i])) for i in idx]

print("P4 row0 (A4 lead + stab + bass + kick)")
print(spectrum_peaks(4*pat_s+0.04, 0.18, 3000))
print("P4 row4 (D5)")
print(spectrum_peaks(4*pat_s+4*row_s+0.04, 0.2, 3000))
print("P0 pad")
print(spectrum_peaks(0.3, 0.6, 2000))
print("P6 pad+lead")
print(spectrum_peaks(6*pat_s+0.4, 0.6, 2000))

# where does energy above 3k come from? compare a hat-only moment vs lead moment
# hats every 2 rows. look at high band fraction without assuming
def hf(t0, dur):
    seg=mono[int(t0*sr):int((t0+dur)*sr)]
    spec=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg*np.hanning(len(seg))))
    freqs=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(seg),1/sr)
    tot=spec.sum()+1
    return round(float(spec[freqs>3000].sum()/tot),3), round(float(spec[(freqs>800)&(freqs<2500)].sum()/tot),3)

print("hf >3k / mid 0.8-2.5k")
print("intro", hf(0.4, 0.5))
print("p2 groove", hf(2*pat_s+0.3, 0.5))
print("p4 hook", hf(4*pat_s+0.3, 0.5))
print("p6 break", hf(6*pat_s+0.4, 0.5))
print("p7 harm", hf(7*pat_s+0.3, 0.5))

# dynamic contour per bar inside pattern 4 and 7 (is the hook shaped?)
print("--- bar rms p4 and p7 and p12 ---")
for pi in (4,7,12,15):
    s0=int(pi*pat_s*sr)
    vals=[]
    for bar in range(4):
        s=s0+int(bar*16*row_s*sr); e=s+int(16*row_s*sr)
        vals.append(int(np.sqrt(np.mean(mono[s:e]**2))))
    print(pi, vals)

import wave, numpy as np
w=wave.open("/tmp/tune_preview.wav")
d=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype=np.int16).reshape(-1,2).astype(np.float32)
sr=w.getframerate(); mono=d.mean(1)
row_s=5*2.5/136; pat_s=64*row_s
print("peak", float(np.max(np.abs(d))), "clips", int(np.sum(np.max(np.abs(d),1)>30000)))
def bands(sig):
    spec=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(sig*np.hanning(len(sig))))
    freqs=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(sig),1/sr)
    def b(a,c): return spec[(freqs>=a)&(freqs<c)].sum()
    parts=[b(25,100),b(100,400),b(400,1800),b(1800,5000),b(5000,11000)]
    t=sum(parts)+1
    return [round(float(x/t),2) for x in parts]
print("         sub  low  mid  hi  air")
for i in range(16):
    s=int(i*pat_s*sr); e=int(min(len(d),(i+1)*pat_s*sr))
    ch=d[s:e]
    rms=np.sqrt(np.mean(ch**2)); pk=np.max(np.abs(ch))
    side=(ch[:,0]-ch[:,1])/2; mid=ch.mean(1)
    width=np.sqrt(np.mean(side**2))/(np.sqrt(np.mean(mid**2))+1e-9)
    print(f"p{i:02d} rms {rms:5.0f} pk {pk:5.0f} w {width:.2f} bands {bands(mono[s:e])}")

def fund(t0,dur,lo=30,hi=1200):
    seg=mono[int(t0*sr):int((t0+dur)*sr)]
    seg=(seg-seg.mean())*np.hanning(len(seg))
    spec=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg)); freqs=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(seg),1/sr)
    spec[(freqs<lo)|(freqs>hi)]=0
    return round(float(freqs[np.argmax(spec)]),1)
print("bass", fund(2*pat_s+0.1,0.3,30,200))
print("A4", fund(4*pat_s+0.06,0.2,200,800))
print("D5", fund(4*pat_s+4*row_s+0.06,0.2,300,1000))
print("pad", fund(0.4,0.5,80,400))
print("end/start rms", float(np.sqrt(np.mean(mono[-int(0.2*sr):]**2))), float(np.sqrt(np.mean(mono[:int(0.2*sr)]**2))))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
SERIAL VELOCITY
Original keygen module in D minor, 132 BPM, 8 channels.
Instruments are synthesized; pitches, rhythm and arrangement live in the patterns.
C-4 on a period-16 sample sounds concert C4 in this renderer.
Bass / pad / stab samples use period 32 (sound one octave lower) and are
written one octave higher so tracker note names match sounding pitch.
"""
import json, os, base64
import numpy as np

OUT = "/tmp/tune_calls.json"
PLAY = 4181.5

NAMES = ["C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "G#", "A", "A#", "B"]

def nn(midi):
    return f"{NAMES[midi % 12]}-{midi // 12 - 1}"

def xv(level):
    return 16 + int(round(max(0, min(64, level))))

def b64(x):
    x = np.clip(np.asarray(x, np.float32), -1, 1)
    return base64.b64encode(x.tobytes()).decode("ascii")

def norm(x, peak=0.9):
    m = np.max(np.abs(x)) + 1e-12
    return x * (peak / m)

def lop(x, coeff):
    y = np.empty(len(x), dtype=np.float64)
    acc = 0.0
    for i, s in enumerate(np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)):
        acc += coeff * (s - acc)
        y[i] = acc
    return y

# ---------------- samples ----------------
def bass_loop():
    period, cycles = 32, 12
    n = period * cycles
    t = np.arange(n)
    ph = 2 * np.pi * t / period
    x = np.sin(ph) + 0.40 * np.sin(2 * ph) + 0.12 * np.sin(3 * ph)
    x = np.tanh(1.7 * x)
    x = lop(x, 0.42)
    return norm(x, 0.95)

def lead_loop():
    period, cycles = 16, 24
    n = period * cycles
    t = np.arange(n)
    ph = 2 * np.pi * t / period
    x = np.sin(ph) + 0.28 * np.sin(3 * ph) + 0.10 * np.sin(2 * ph + 0.5)
    x += 0.06 * np.sin(ph + 2 * np.pi * t / n)
    x = np.tanh(0.9 * x)
    x = lop(x, 0.36)
    return norm(x, 0.76)

def lead_soft():
    period, cycles = 16, 24
    n = period * cycles
    t = np.arange(n)
    ph = 2 * np.pi * t / period
    x = np.sin(ph + 0.4) + 0.16 * np.sin(2 * ph) + 0.05 * np.sin(ph - 2 * np.pi * t / n)
    x = np.tanh(0.8 * x)
    x = lop(x, 0.32)
    return norm(x, 0.70)

def pad_loop():
    period, cycles = 32, 16
    n = period * cycles
    t = np.arange(n)
    ph = 2 * np.pi * t / period
    x = 0.75 * np.sin(ph) + 0.12 * np.sin(2 * ph + 0.3)
    x += 0.22 * np.sin(ph + 4 * np.pi * t / n)
    x += 0.16 * np.sin(ph - 6 * np.pi * t / n + 0.8)
    x *= 0.92 + 0.08 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * t / n)
    x = np.tanh(0.8 * x)
    x = lop(x, 0.28)
    return norm(x, 0.68)

def stab():
    n = int(0.42 * PLAY)
    period = 32.0
    t = np.arange(n)
    x = np.zeros(n)
    for h, a, tau in ((1, 1.0, 0.22), (2, 0.22, 0.07), (3, 0.06, 0.03)):
        x += a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * h * t / period) * np.exp(-t / (tau * PLAY))
    x = lop(np.tanh(0.85 * x), 0.34)
    x[-48:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 48)
    return norm(x, 0.74)

def arp():
    n = int(0.28 * PLAY)
    period = 16.0
    t = np.arange(n)
    x = np.sin(2 * np.pi * t / period) * np.exp(-t / (0.13 * PLAY))
    x += 0.18 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 2 * t / period) * np.exp(-t / (0.05 * PLAY))
    x = lop(x, 0.40)
    x[-32:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 32)
    return norm(x, 0.72)

def bell():
    n = int(1.15 * PLAY)
    period = 16.0
    t = np.arange(n)
    idx = 1.15 * np.exp(-t / (0.22 * PLAY))
    mod = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 2 * t / period)
    x = np.sin(2 * np.pi * t / period + idx * mod) * np.exp(-t / (0.48 * PLAY))
    x += 0.18 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * t / period) * np.exp(-t / (0.18 * PLAY))
    x = lop(x, 0.30)
    x[-90:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 90)
    return norm(x, 0.68)

def kick():
    n = int(0.46 * PLAY)
    t = np.arange(n) / PLAY
    f = 46 + (78 - 46) * np.exp(-t / 0.07)
    ph = 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / PLAY
    x = np.sin(ph) * np.exp(-t / 0.20) + 0.65 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 50 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.22)
    x = np.tanh(1.2 * x)
    x[-36:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 36)
    return norm(x, 0.96)

def snare():
    n = int(0.20 * PLAY)
    t = np.arange(n) / PLAY
    rng = np.random.default_rng(11)
    noise = rng.uniform(-1, 1, n)
    noise = np.convolve(noise, np.ones(7) / 7, mode="same")
    body = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 176 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.09)
    x = 0.28 * noise * np.exp(-t / 0.055) + 0.62 * body
    x = np.tanh(x)
    x[-24:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 24)
    return norm(x, 0.72)

def hat(open_=False):
    n = int((0.18 if open_ else 0.045) * PLAY)
    t = np.arange(n) / PLAY
    rng = np.random.default_rng(8 if not open_ else 19)
    noise = rng.uniform(-1, 1, n)
    noise = np.convolve(noise, np.ones(3) / 3, mode="same")
    met = np.zeros(n)
    for f in ((900, 1400, 1800) if not open_ else (700, 1100, 1500)):
        met += np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t)
    met /= 3
    tau = 0.08 if open_ else 0.016
    x = (0.30 * noise + 0.70 * met) * np.exp(-t / tau)
    x = lop(x, 0.42)
    fade = 16 if not open_ else 28
    x[-fade:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, fade)
    return norm(x, 0.40 if not open_ else 0.36)

# ---------------- arrangement primitives ----------------
# MIDI = sounding pitch
C2, D2, E2, F2, G2, A2, Bb2, B2 = 36, 38, 40, 41, 43, 45, 46, 47
Cs2, Cs3 = 37, 49
C3, D3, E3, F3, G3, A3, Bb3 = 48, 50, 52, 53, 55, 57, 58
C4, D4, E4, F4, G4, A4, Bb4, B4 = 60, 62, 64, 65, 67, 69, 70, 71
Cs4, Cs5 = 61, 73
C5, D5, E5, F5, G5, A5, Bb5 = 72, 74, 76, 77, 79, 81, 82

KICK, SNARE, HAT, OHAT = 1, 2, 3, 4
BASS, LEAD, SOFT, PAD = 5, 6, 7, 8
BELL, STAB, ARP = 9, 10, 11
LOW_INST = (BASS, PAD, STAB)

# 0 kick C, 1 snare L, 2 hats R, 3 bass C, 4 chord L, 5 chord R, 6 arp/harmony LC, 7 lead RC
PAN = {0: 0x80, 1: 0x48, 2: 0xC0, 3: 0x80, 4: 0x00, 5: 0xFF, 6: 0x28, 7: 0xD8}

class Pat:
    def __init__(self, rows=64):
        self.rows = rows
        self.cells = {}

    def put(self, ch, row, note=None, inst=None, vol=None, fx=0, fp=0):
        if not (0 <= row < self.rows):
            return
        k = (ch, row)
        o = self.cells.get(k)
        if o is None:
            self.cells[k] = dict(channel=ch, row=row, note=note, instrument=inst,
                                 volume=None if vol is None else xv(vol),
                                 effect=fx, effect_param=fp)
            return
        if note is not None:
            o["note"] = note
            if inst is not None:
                o["instrument"] = inst
        if vol is not None:
            o["volume"] = xv(vol)
        if fx:
            o["effect"] = fx
            o["effect_param"] = fp

    def n(self, ch, row, midi, inst, vol=40):
        if inst in LOW_INST:
            midi += 12
        self.put(ch, row, note=nn(midi), inst=inst, vol=vol, fx=8, fp=PAN[ch])

    def off(self, ch, row):
        self.put(ch, row, note=97, fx=8, fp=PAN[ch])

    def vib(self, ch, row, speed=3, depth=3):
        self.put(ch, row, fx=4, fp=(speed << 4) | depth)

    def slide(self, ch, row, param=0x02):
        self.put(ch, row, fx=0xA, fp=param)

def drums(p, style="groove", kv=46, sv=34, hv=18):
    """Hats on 8ths (every 4 rows) so the top end stays airy, not a white-noise bed."""
    if style != "nodrum":
        for step in range(16):
            row = step * 4
            if style == "break" and row >= 48:
                break
            inst = OHAT if (style in ("groove", "drive") and step % 4 == 3) else HAT
            v = hv + (3 if step % 4 == 0 else 0)
            p.n(2, row, C5, inst, vol=v)
    if style == "nodrum":
        return
    if style == "pulse":
        p.n(0, 0, C3, KICK, kv - 8)
        p.n(0, 32, C3, KICK, kv - 12)
        p.n(0, 48, C3, KICK, kv - 6)
        return
    if style == "half":
        for r in (0, 16, 32, 48):
            p.n(0, r, C3, KICK, kv)
        for r in (8, 24, 40, 56):
            p.n(1, r, D3, SNARE, sv)
        return
    if style == "break":
        for r in (0, 16, 32, 48):
            p.n(0, r, C3, KICK, kv)
        for r in (8, 24, 40):
            p.n(1, r, D3, SNARE, sv)
        for i, r in enumerate(range(48, 64, 2)):
            p.n(1, r, D3, SNARE, 16 + i * 2)
        return
    # groove / drive: kick on 1 and the and-of-3, snare on 2 and 4, ghost
    kicks = [0, 16, 32, 48]
    extras = [10, 26, 42, 58] if style == "drive" else [12, 28, 44, 60]
    for r in kicks:
        p.n(0, r, C3, KICK, kv)
    for r in extras:
        p.n(0, r, C3, KICK, kv - 10)
    for r in (8, 24, 40, 56):
        p.n(1, r, D3, SNARE, sv)
    if style == "drive":
        p.n(1, 14, D3, SNARE, 14)
        p.n(1, 46, D3, SNARE, 14)

def bass(p, seq):
    """seq: (row, sounding midi, vol). Short note-off before the next hit keeps it plucky."""
    for i, (row, midi, vol) in enumerate(seq):
        p.n(3, row, midi, BASS, vol)
        nxt = seq[i + 1][0] if i + 1 < len(seq) else p.rows
        if nxt - row >= 3 and nxt - 1 < p.rows and nxt < p.rows:
            p.off(3, nxt - 1)

def chords(p, events, inst=STAB):
    """events: (row, left sounding, right sounding, vol)."""
    for row, lo, hi, vol in events:
        p.n(4, row, lo, inst, vol)
        p.n(5, row, hi, inst, max(14, vol - 3))

def melody(p, phrase, vol=40, inst=LEAD, ch=7, vibrato=True):
    ons = []
    for row, midi, length in phrase:
        p.n(ch, row, midi, inst, vol)
        ons.append((row, length))
        if vibrato and length >= 8 and row + 4 < p.rows:
            p.vib(ch, row + 4, 3, 3)
        if length >= 8:
            fr = row + length - 2
            if 0 <= fr < p.rows:
                p.slide(ch, fr, 0x02)
    for i, (row, length) in enumerate(ons):
        end = row + length
        nxt = ons[i + 1][0] if i + 1 < len(ons) else 10_000
        if end < p.rows and end < nxt:
            p.off(ch, end)

def arp_line(p, notes, step=2, vol=24, inst=ARP, ch=6, start=0):
    for i, m in enumerate(notes):
        row = start + i * step
        if row >= p.rows:
            break
        p.n(ch, row, m, inst, vol + (2 if i % 4 == 0 else 0))

# ---------- the tune ----------
# 4-bar chord loop, each bar 16 rows:
#   Dm | Bb | F | A     (i - VI - III - V)  classic keygen cadence, loops to itself.
#
# Hook (the thing you hum):
#   A4  D5--  C5 A4 | Bb4-- A4  G4 A4 | F4 G4 A4--- | E4 F4 G4 A4
#
# Bass sounding roots with octave pops, never below C2.

def bass_walking(v=44):
    return [
        (0, D2, v), (6, D3, v - 12), (8, A2, v - 6), (12, F2, v - 10),
        (16, Bb2, v), (22, D3, v - 12), (24, F2, v - 6), (30, Bb2, v - 10),
        (32, F2, v), (38, C3, v - 12), (40, A2, v - 6), (44, C3, v - 10),
        (48, A2, v), (54, E2, v - 10), (56, Cs3, v - 8), (62, E2, v - 12),
    ]

def bass_push(v=46):
    return [
        (0, D2, v), (4, A2, v - 14), (8, D2, v - 4), (12, F2, v - 12),
        (16, Bb2, v), (20, F2, v - 14), (24, Bb2, v - 4), (28, D3, v - 12),
        (32, C2, v), (36, G2, v - 14), (40, C2, v - 4), (44, E2, v - 12),
        (48, A2, v), (52, E2, v - 14), (56, A2, v - 4), (60, Cs3, v - 10),
    ]

def bass_half(v=40):
    return [(0, D2, v), (16, Bb2, v - 2), (32, F2, v - 2), (48, A2, v)]

def bass_bridge(v=42):
    return [
        (0, G2, v), (8, D3, v - 10), (12, Bb2, v - 8),
        (16, Bb2, v), (24, F2, v - 8), (28, D3, v - 10),
        (32, A2, v + 2), (40, E2, v - 8), (44, G2, v - 10),
        (48, A2, v), (56, E2, v - 8), (60, Cs3, v - 6),
    ]

def hook():
    return [
        (0, A4, 4), (4, D5, 6), (10, C5, 2), (12, A4, 4),
        (16, Bb4, 6), (22, A4, 2), (24, G4, 4), (28, A4, 4),
        (32, F4, 4), (36, G4, 4), (40, A4, 8),
        (48, E4, 4), (52, F4, 4), (56, G4, 4), (60, A4, 4),
    ]

def hook_b():
    return [
        (0, D5, 4), (4, F5, 4), (8, E5, 4), (12, D5, 4),
        (16, C5, 6), (22, Bb4, 2), (24, A4, 8),
        (32, C5, 4), (36, D5, 4), (40, F5, 6), (46, E5, 2),
        (48, D5, 4), (52, C5, 4), (56, Bb4, 4), (60, A4, 4),
    ]

def hook_thirds():
    return [
        (0, F4, 4), (4, A4, 6), (10, G4, 2), (12, F4, 4),
        (16, G4, 6), (22, F4, 2), (24, E4, 4), (28, F4, 4),
        (32, D4, 4), (36, E4, 4), (40, F4, 8),
        (48, Cs4, 4), (52, D4, 4), (56, E4, 4), (60, F4, 4),
    ]

def answer():
    return [
        (0, F5, 4), (4, E5, 2), (6, D5, 2), (8, C5, 6), (14, A4, 2),
        (16, Bb4, 4), (20, C5, 4), (24, D5, 8),
        (32, C5, 4), (36, Bb4, 4), (40, A4, 8),
        (48, G4, 4), (52, A4, 4), (56, F4, 8),

    return [
        (0, D5, 2), (2, E5, 2), (4, F5, 4), (8, E5, 2), (10, D5, 2), (12, C5, 4),
        (16, Bb4, 2), (18, C5, 2), (20, D5, 6), (28, A4, 4),
        (32, G4, 4), (36, A4, 4), (40, Bb4, 4), (44, A4, 4),
        (48, G4, 4), (52, F4, 4), (56, E4, 4), (60, D4, 4),

# arp figures stay inside one octave-plus, no random +12 jumps
ARP_DM = [D4, F4, A4, D5, A4, F4, E4, F4]
ARP_BB = [Bb3, D4, F4, Bb4, F4, D4, C4, D4]

def seq(*blocks):
    out = []
    for b in blocks:
        out.extend(b)
    return out

    (0, D4, A4, 28),
    (16, Bb3, F4, 26),
    (32, F3, C4, 26),
    (48, A3, E4, 30),
]

    (16, D4, Bb4, 24),
    (32, C4, A4, 24),
    (48, Cs4, A4, 28),
]

def make_patterns():
    P = []

    # 0 intro — wide pad, a bell hinting at the hook, one kick
    p = Pat(); 
    chords(p, [(0, D3, A3, 22), (16, Bb3, F4, 20), (32, F3, C4, 20), (48, A3, E4, 22)], inst=PAD)
    for row, m in ((0, A4), (8, D5), (16, F5), (24, D5), (32, C5), (40, A4), (48, E5), (56, Cs5)):
        p.n(6, row, m, BELL, 26)
    melody(p, [(32, A4, 12), (48, E5, 10)], vol=24, inst=SOFT, vibrato=True)
    drums(p, "pulse", kv=34)
    P.append(p)

    # 1 bass enters, half-time, arp states the progression
    p = Pat()
    chords(p, [(0, D3, A3, 18), (16, Bb3, F4, 16), (32, F3, C4, 16), (48, A3, E4, 18)], inst=PAD)
    drums(p, "half", kv=38, sv=26, hv=14)
    bass(p, bass_half(40))
    arp_line(p, seq(ARP_DM, ARP_BB, ARP_F, ARP_A), step=2, vol=22, inst=ARP)

def build():

        print(f"  smp {iname:9s} {len(pcm):5d}")

    for i, p in enumerate(pats):
        calls.append({"name": "pattern_set_length", "arguments": {"pattern": i, "rows": 64}})
        calls.append({"name": "order_set", "arguments": {"position": i, "pattern": i}})
        for c in p.cells.values():

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
SERIAL VELOCITY
Original keygen module in D minor, 132 BPM, 8 channels.
Instruments are synthesized; pitches, rhythm and arrangement live in the patterns.
C-4 on a period-16 sample sounds concert C4 in this renderer.
Bass / pad / stab samples use period 32 (sound one octave lower) and are
written one octave higher so tracker note names match sounding pitch.
"""
import json, os, base64
import numpy as np

OUT = "/tmp/tune_calls.json"
PLAY = 4181.5

NAMES = ["C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "G#", "A", "A#", "B"]

def nn(midi):
    return f"{NAMES[midi % 12]}-{midi // 12 - 1}"

def xv(level):
    return 16 + int(round(max(0, min(64, level))))

def b64(x):
    x = np.clip(np.asarray(x, np.float32), -1, 1)
    return base64.b64encode(x.tobytes()).decode("ascii")

def norm(x, peak=0.9):
    m = np.max(np.abs(x)) + 1e-12
    return x * (peak / m)

def lop(x, coeff):
    y = np.empty(len(x), dtype=np.float64)
    acc = 0.0
    for i, s in enumerate(np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)):
        acc += coeff * (s - acc)
        y[i] = acc
    return y

# ---------------- samples ----------------
def bass_loop():
    period, cycles = 32, 12
    n = period * cycles
    t = np.arange(n)
    ph = 2 * np.pi * t / period
    x = np.sin(ph) + 0.40 * np.sin(2 * ph) + 0.12 * np.sin(3 * ph)
    x = np.tanh(1.7 * x)
    x = lop(x, 0.42)
    return norm(x, 0.95)

def lead_loop():
    period, cycles = 16, 24
    n = period * cycles
    t = np.arange(n)
    ph = 2 * np.pi * t / period
    x = np.sin(ph) + 0.28 * np.sin(3 * ph) + 0.10 * np.sin(2 * ph + 0.5)
    x += 0.06 * np.sin(ph + 2 * np.pi * t / n)
    x = np.tanh(0.9 * x)
    x = lop(x, 0.36)
    return norm(x, 0.76)

def lead_soft():
    period, cycles = 16, 24
    n = period * cycles
    t = np.arange(n)
    ph = 2 * np.pi * t / period
    x = np.sin(ph + 0.4) + 0.16 * np.sin(2 * ph) + 0.05 * np.sin(ph - 2 * np.pi * t / n)
    x = np.tanh(0.8 * x)
    x = lop(x, 0.32)
    return norm(x, 0.70)

def pad_loop():
    period, cycles = 32, 16
    n = period * cycles
    t = np.arange(n)
    ph = 2 * np.pi * t / period
    x = 0.75 * np.sin(ph) + 0.12 * np.sin(2 * ph + 0.3)
    x += 0.22 * np.sin(ph + 4 * np.pi * t / n)
    x += 0.16 * np.sin(ph - 6 * np.pi * t / n + 0.8)
    x *= 0.92 + 0.08 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * t / n)
    x = np.tanh(0.8 * x)
    x = lop(x, 0.28)
    return norm(x, 0.68)

def stab():
    n = int(0.42 * PLAY)
    period = 32.0
    t = np.arange(n)
    x = np.zeros(n)
    for h, a, tau in ((1, 1.0, 0.22), (2, 0.22, 0.07), (3, 0.06, 0.03)):
        x += a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * h * t / period) * np.exp(-t / (tau * PLAY))
    x = lop(np.tanh(0.85 * x), 0.34)
    x[-48:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 48)
    return norm(x, 0.74)

def arp():
    n = int(0.28 * PLAY)
    period = 16.0
    t = np.arange(n)
    x = np.sin(2 * np.pi * t / period) * np.exp(-t / (0.13 * PLAY))
    x += 0.18 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 2 * t / period) * np.exp(-t / (0.05 * PLAY))
    x = lop(x, 0.40)
    x[-32:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 32)
    return norm(x, 0.72)

def bell():
    n = int(1.15 * PLAY)
    period = 16.0
    t = np.arange(n)
    idx = 1.15 * np.exp(-t / (0.22 * PLAY))
    mod = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 2 * t / period)
    x = np.sin(2 * np.pi * t / period + idx * mod) * np.exp(-t / (0.48 * PLAY))
    x += 0.18 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * t / period) * np.exp(-t / (0.18 * PLAY))
    x = lop(x, 0.30)
    x[-90:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 90)
    return norm(x, 0.68)

def kick():
    n = int(0.46 * PLAY)
    t = np.arange(n) / PLAY
    f = 46 + (78 - 46) * np.exp(-t / 0.07)
    ph = 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / PLAY
    x = np.sin(ph) * np.exp(-t / 0.20) + 0.65 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 50 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.22)
    x = np.tanh(1.2 * x)
    x[-36:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 36)
    return norm(x, 0.96)

def snare():
    n = int(0.20 * PLAY)
    t = np.arange(n) / PLAY
    rng = np.random.default_rng(11)
    noise = rng.uniform(-1, 1, n)
    noise = np.convolve(noise, np.ones(7) / 7, mode="same")
    body = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 176 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.09)
    x = 0.28 * noise * np.exp(-t / 0.055) + 0.62 * body
    x = np.tanh(x)
    x[-24:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 24)
    return norm(x, 0.72)

def hat(open_=False):
    n = int((0.18 if open_ else 0.045) * PLAY)
    t = np.arange(n) / PLAY
    rng = np.random.default_rng(8 if not open_ else 19)
    noise = rng.uniform(-1, 1, n)
    noise = np.convolve(noise, np.ones(3) / 3, mode="same")
    met = np.zeros(n)
    for f in ((900, 1400, 1800) if not open_ else (700, 1100, 1500)):
        met += np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t)
    met /= 3
    tau = 0.08 if open_ else 0.016
    x = (0.30 * noise + 0.70 * met) * np.exp(-t / tau)
    x = lop(x, 0.42)
    fade = 16 if not open_ else 28
    x[-fade:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, fade)
    return norm(x, 0.40 if not open_ else 0.36)

# ---------------- arrangement primitives ----------------
# MIDI = sounding pitch
C2, D2, E2, F2, G2, A2, Bb2, B2 = 36, 38, 40, 41, 43, 45, 46, 47
Cs2, Cs3 = 37, 49
C3, D3, E3, F3, G3, A3, Bb3 = 48, 50, 52, 53, 55, 57, 58
C4, D4, E4, F4, G4, A4, Bb4, B4 = 60, 62, 64, 65, 67, 69, 70, 71
Cs4, Cs5 = 61, 73
C5, D5, E5, F5, G5, A5, Bb5 = 72, 74, 76, 77, 79, 81, 82

KICK, SNARE, HAT, OHAT = 1, 2, 3, 4
BASS, LEAD, SOFT, PAD = 5, 6, 7, 8
BELL, STAB, ARP = 9, 10, 11
LOW_INST = (BASS, PAD, STAB)

# 0 kick C, 1 snare L, 2 hats R, 3 bass C, 4 chord L, 5 chord R, 6 arp/harmony LC, 7 lead RC
PAN = {0: 0x80, 1: 0x48, 2: 0xC0, 3: 0x80, 4: 0x00, 5: 0xFF, 6: 0x28, 7: 0xD8}

class Pat:
    def __init__(self, rows=64):
        self.rows = rows
        self.cells = {}

    def put(self, ch, row, note=None, inst=None, vol=None, fx=0, fp=0):
        if not (0 <= row < self.rows):
            return
        k = (ch, row)
        o = self.cells.get(k)
        if o is None:
            self.cells[k] = dict(channel=ch, row=row, note=note, instrument=inst,
                                 volume=None if vol is None else xv(vol),
                                 effect=fx, effect_param=fp)
            return
        if note is not None:
            o["note"] = note
            if inst is not None:
                o["instrument"] = inst
        if vol is not None:
            o["volume"] = xv(vol)
        if fx:
            o["effect"] = fx
            o["effect_param"] = fp

    def n(self, ch, row, midi, inst, vol=40):
        if inst in LOW_INST:
            midi += 12
        self.put(ch, row, note=nn(midi), inst=inst, vol=vol, fx=8, fp=PAN[ch])

    def off(self, ch, row):
        self.put(ch, row, note=97, fx=8, fp=PAN[ch])

    def vib(self, ch, row, speed=3, depth=3):
        self.put(ch, row, fx=4, fp=(speed << 4) | depth)

    def slide(self, ch, row, param=0x02):
        self.put(ch, row, fx=0xA, fp=param)

def drums(p, style="groove", kv=46, sv=34, hv=18):
    """Hats on 8ths (every 4 rows) so the top end stays airy, not a white-noise bed."""
    if style != "nodrum":
        for step in range(16):
            row = step * 4
            if style == "break" and row >= 48:
                break
            inst = OHAT if (style in ("groove", "drive") and step % 4 == 3) else HAT
            v = hv + (3 if step % 4 == 0 else 0)
            p.n(2, row, C5, inst, vol=v)
    if style == "nodrum":
        return
    if style == "pulse":
        p.n(0, 0, C3, KICK, kv - 8)
        p.n(0, 32, C3, KICK, kv - 12)
        p.n(0, 48, C3, KICK, kv - 6)
        return
    if style == "half":
        for r in (0, 16, 32, 48):
            p.n(0, r, C3, KICK, kv)
        for r in (8, 24, 40, 56):
            p.n(1, r, D3, SNARE, sv)
        return
    if style == "break":
        for r in (0, 16, 32, 48):
            p.n(0, r, C3, KICK, kv)
        for r in (8, 24, 40):
            p.n(1, r, D3, SNARE, sv)
        for i, r in enumerate(range(48, 64, 2)):
            p.n(1, r, D3, SNARE, 16 + i * 2)
        return
    # groove / drive: kick on 1 and the and-of-3, snare on 2 and 4, ghost
    kicks = [0, 16, 32, 48]
    extras = [10, 26, 42, 58] if style == "drive" else [12, 28, 44, 60]
    for r in kicks:
        p.n(0, r, C3, KICK, kv)
    for r in extras:
        p.n(0, r, C3, KICK, kv - 10)
    for r in (8, 24, 40, 56):
        p.n(1, r, D3, SNARE, sv)
    if style == "drive":
        p.n(1, 14, D3, SNARE, 14)
        p.n(1, 46, D3, SNARE, 14)

def bass(p, seq):
    """seq: (row, sounding midi, vol). Short note-off before the next hit keeps it plucky."""
    for i, (row, midi, vol) in enumerate(seq):
        p.n(3, row, midi, BASS, vol)
        nxt = seq[i + 1][0] if i + 1 < len(seq) else p.rows
        if nxt - row >= 3 and nxt - 1 < p.rows and nxt < p.rows:
            p.off(3, nxt - 1)

def chords(p, events, inst=STAB):
    """events: (row, left sounding, right sounding, vol)."""
    for row, lo, hi, vol in events:
        p.n(4, row, lo, inst, vol)
        p.n(5, row, hi, inst, max(14, vol - 3))

def melody(p, phrase, vol=40, inst=LEAD, ch=7, vibrato=True):
    ons = []
    for row, midi, length in phrase:
        p.n(ch, row, midi, inst, vol)
        ons.append((row, length))
        if vibrato and length >= 8 and row + 4 < p.rows:
            p.vib(ch, row + 4, 3, 3)
        if length >= 8:
            fr = row + length - 2
            if 0 <= fr < p.rows:
                p.slide(ch, fr, 0x02)
    for i, (row, length) in enumerate(ons):
        end = row + length
        nxt = ons[i + 1][0] if i + 1 < len(ons) else 10_000

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
SERIAL VELOCITY
Original keygen module in D minor, 132 BPM, 8 channels.
Instruments are synthesized; pitches, rhythm and arrangement live in the patterns.
C-4 on a period-16 sample sounds concert C4 in this renderer.
Bass / pad / stab samples use period 32 (sound one octave lower) and are
written one octave higher so tracker note names match sounding pitch.
"""
import json, os, base64
import numpy as np

OUT = "/tmp/tune_calls.json"
PLAY = 4181.5

NAMES = ["C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "G#", "A", "A#", "B"]

def nn(midi):
    return f"{NAMES[midi % 12]}-{midi // 12 - 1}"

def xv(level):
    return 16 + int(round(max(0, min(64, level))))

def b64(x):
    x = np.clip(np.asarray(x, np.float32), -1, 1)
    return base64.b64encode(x.tobytes()).decode("ascii")

def norm(x, peak=0.9):
    m = np.max(np.abs(x)) + 1e-12
    return x * (peak / m)

def lop(x, coeff):
    y = np.empty(len(x), dtype=np.float64)
    acc = 0.0
    for i, s in enumerate(np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)):
        acc += coeff * (s - acc)
        y[i] = acc
    return y

# ---------------- samples ----------------
def bass_loop():
    period, cycles = 32, 12
    n = period * cycles
    t = np.arange(n)
    ph = 2 * np.pi * t / period
    x = np.sin(ph) + 0.40 * np.sin(2 * ph) + 0.12 * np.sin(3 * ph)
    x = np.tanh(1.7 * x)
    x = lop(x, 0.42)
    return norm(x, 0.95)

def lead_loop():
    period, cycles = 16, 24
    n = period * cycles
    t = np.arange(n)
    ph = 2 * np.pi * t / period
    x = np.sin(ph) + 0.28 * np.sin(3 * ph) + 0.10 * np.sin(2 * ph + 0.5)
    x += 0.06 * np.sin(ph + 2 * np.pi * t / n)
    x = np.tanh(0.9 * x)
    x = lop(x, 0.36)
    return norm(x, 0.76)

def lead_soft():
    period, cycles = 16, 24
    n = period * cycles
    t = np.arange(n)
    ph = 2 * np.pi * t / period
    x = np.sin(ph + 0.4) + 0.16 * np.sin(2 * ph) + 0.05 * np.sin(ph - 2 * np.pi * t / n)
    x = np.tanh(0.8 * x)
    x = lop(x, 0.32)
    return norm(x, 0.70)

def pad_loop():
    period, cycles = 32, 16
    n = period * cycles
    t = np.arange(n)
    ph = 2 * np.pi * t / period
    x = 0.75 * np.sin(ph) + 0.12 * np.sin(2 * ph + 0.3)
    x += 0.22 * np.sin(ph + 4 * np.pi * t / n)
    x += 0.16 * np.sin(ph - 6 * np.pi * t / n + 0.8)
    x *= 0.92 + 0.08 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * t / n)
    x = np.tanh(0.8 * x)
    x = lop(x, 0.28)
    return norm(x, 0.68)

def stab():
    n = int(0.42 * PLAY)
    period = 32.0
    t = np.arange(n)

def snare():
    n = int(0.20 * PLAY)
    t = np.arange(n) / PLAY
    rng = np.random.default_rng(11)
    noise = rng.uniform(-1, 1, n)
    noise = np.convolve(noise, np.ones(7) / 7, mode="same")
    body = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 176 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.09)
    x = 0.28 * noise * np.exp(-t / 0.055) + 0.62 * body
    x = np.tanh(x)
    x[-24:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 24)
    return norm(x, 0.72)

def hat(open_=False):
    n = int((0.18 if open_ else 0.045) * PLAY)
    t = np.arange(n) / PLAY
    rng = np.random.default_rng(8 if not open_ else 19)
    noise = rng.uniform(-1, 1, n)
    noise = np.convolve(noise, np.ones(3) / 3, mode="same")
    met = np.zeros(n)
    for f in ((900, 1400, 1800) if not open_ else (700, 1100, 1500)):
        met += np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t)
    met /= 3
    tau = 0.08 if open_ else 0.016
    x = (0.30 * noise + 0.70 * met) * np.exp(-t / tau)
    x = lop(x, 0.42)
    fade = 16 if not open_ else 28
    x[-fade:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, fade)
    return norm(x, 0.40 if not open_ else 0.36)

# ---------------- arrangement primitives ----------------
# MIDI = sounding pitch
C2, D2, E2, F2, G2, A2, Bb2, B2 = 36, 38, 40, 41, 43, 45, 46, 47
Cs2, Cs3 = 37, 49
C3, D3, E3, F3, G3, A3, Bb3 = 48, 50, 52, 53, 55, 57, 58
C4, D4, E4, F4, G4, A4, Bb4, B4 = 60, 62, 64, 65, 67, 69, 70, 71
Cs4, Cs5 = 61, 73
C5, D5, E5, F5, G5, A5, Bb5 = 72, 74, 76, 77, 79, 81, 82

KICK, SNARE, HAT, OHAT = 1, 2, 3, 4
BASS, LEAD, SOFT, PAD = 5, 6, 7, 8
BELL, STAB, ARP = 9, 10, 11
LOW_INST = (BASS, PAD, STAB)

# 0 kick C, 1 snare L, 2 hats R, 3 bass C, 4 chord L, 5 chord R, 6 arp/harmony LC, 7 lead RC
PAN = {0: 0x80, 1: 0x48, 2: 0xC0, 3: 0x80, 4: 0x00, 5: 0xFF, 6: 0x28, 7: 0xD8}

class Pat:
    def __init__(self, rows=64):
        self.rows = rows
        self.cells = {}

    def put(self, ch, row, note=None, inst=None, vol=None, fx=0, fp=0):
        if not (0 <= row < self.rows):
            return
        k = (ch, row)
        o = self.cells.get(k)
        if o is None:
            self.cells[k] = dict(channel=ch, row=row, note=note, instrument=inst,
                                 volume=None if vol is None else xv(vol),
                                 effect=fx, effect_param=fp)
            return
        if note is not None:
            o["note"] = note
            if inst is not None:
                o["instrument"] = inst
        if vol is not None:
            o["volume"] = xv(vol)
        if fx:
            o["effect"] = fx
            o["effect_param"] = fp

    def n(self, ch, row, midi, inst, vol=40):
        if inst in LOW_INST:
            midi += 12
        self.put(ch, row, note=nn(midi), inst=inst, vol=vol, fx=8, fp=PAN[ch])

    def off(self, ch, row):
        self.put(ch, row, note=97, fx=8, fp=PAN[ch])

    def vib(self, ch, row, speed=3, depth=3):
        self.put(ch, row, fx=4, fp=(speed << 4) | depth)

    def slide(self, ch, row, param=0x02):
        self.put(ch, row, fx=0xA, fp=param)

def drums(p, style="groove", kv=46, sv=34, hv=18):
    """Hats on 8ths (every 4 rows) so the top end stays airy, not a white-noise bed."""
    if style != "nodrum":
        for step in range(16):
            row = step * 4
            if style == "break" and row >= 48:
                break
            inst = OHAT if (style in ("groove", "drive") and step % 4 == 3) else HAT
            v = hv + (3 if step % 4 == 0 else 0)
            p.n(2, row, C5, inst, vol=v)
    if style == "nodrum":
        return
    if style == "pulse":
        p.n(0, 0, C3, KICK, kv - 8)
        p.n(0, 32, C3, KICK, kv - 12)
        p.n(0, 48, C3, KICK, kv - 6)
        return
    if style == "half":
        for r in (0, 16, 32, 48):
            p.n(0, r, C3, KICK, kv)
        for r in (8, 24, 40, 56):
            p.n(1, r, D3, SNARE, sv)
        return
    if style == "break":
        for r in (0, 16, 32, 48):
            p.n(0, r, C3, KICK, kv)
        for r in (8, 24, 40):
            p.n(1, r, D3, SNARE, sv)
        for i, r in enumerate(range(48, 64, 2)):
            p.n(1, r, D3, SNARE, 16 + i * 2)
        return
    # groove / drive: kick on 1 and the and-of-3, snare on 2 and 4, ghost
    kicks = [0, 16, 32, 48]
    extras = [10, 26, 42, 58] if style == "drive" else [12, 28, 44, 60]
    for r in kicks:
        p.n(0, r, C3, KICK, kv)
    for r in extras:
        p.n(0, r, C3, KICK, kv - 10)
    for r in (8, 24, 40, 56):
        p.n(1, r, D3, SNARE, sv)
    if style == "drive":
        p.n(1, 14, D3, SNARE, 14)
        p.n(1, 46, D3, SNARE, 14)

def bass(p, seq):
    """seq: (row, sounding midi, vol). Short note-off before the next hit keeps it plucky."""
    for i, (row, midi, vol) in enumerate(seq):
        p.n(3, row, midi, BASS, vol)
        nxt = seq[i + 1][0] if i + 1 < len(seq) else p.rows
        if nxt - row >= 3 and nxt - 1 < p.rows and nxt < p.rows:
            p.off(3, nxt - 1)

def chords(p, events, inst=STAB):
    """events: (row, left sounding, right sounding, vol)."""
    for row, lo, hi, vol in events:
        p.n(4, row, lo, inst, vol)
        p.n(5, row, hi, inst, max(14, vol - 3))

def melody(p, phrase, vol=40, inst=LEAD, ch=7, vibrato=True):
    ons = []
    for row, midi, length in phrase:
        p.n(ch, row, midi, inst, vol)
        ons.append((row, length))
        if vibrato and length >= 8 and row + 4 < p.rows:
            p.vib(ch, row + 4, 3, 3)
        if length >= 8:
            fr = row + length - 2
            if 0 <= fr < p.rows:
                p.slide(ch, fr, 0x02)
    for i, (row, length) in enumerate(ons):
        end = row + length
        nxt = ons[i + 1][0] if i + 1 < len(ons) else 10_000
        if end < p.rows and end < nxt:
            p.off(ch, end)

def arp_line(p, notes, step=2, vol=24, inst=ARP, ch=6, start=0):
    for i, m in enumerate(notes):
        row = start + i * step
        if row >= p.rows:
            break
        p.n(ch, row, m, inst, vol + (2 if i % 4 == 0 else 0))

# ---------- the tune ----------
# 4-bar chord loop, each bar 16 rows:
#   Dm | Bb | F | A     (i - VI - III - V)  classic keygen cadence, loops to itself.
#
# Hook (the thing you hum):
#   A4  D5--  C5 A4 | Bb4-- A4  G4 A4 | F4 G4 A4--- | E4 F4 G4 A4
#
# Bass sounding roots with octave pops, never below C2.

def bass_walking(v=44):
    return [
        (0, D2, v), (6, D3, v - 12), (8, A2, v - 6), (12, F2, v - 10),
        (16, Bb2, v), (22, D3, v - 12), (24, F2, v - 6), (30, Bb2, v - 10),
        (32, F2, v), (38, C3, v - 12), (40, A2, v - 6), (44, C3, v - 10),
        (48, A2, v), (54, E2, v - 10), (56, Cs3, v - 8), (62, E2, v - 12),
    ]

def bass_push(v=46):
    return [
        (0, D2, v), (4, A2, v - 14), (8, D2, v - 4), (12, F2, v - 12),
        (16, Bb2, v), (20, F2, v - 14), (24, Bb2, v - 4), (28, D3, v - 12),
        (32, C2, v), (36, G2, v - 14), (40, C2, v - 4), (44, E2, v - 12),
        (48, A2, v), (52, E2, v - 14), (56, A2, v - 4), (60, Cs3, v - 10),
    ]

def bass_half(v=40):
    return [(0, D2, v), (16, Bb2, v - 2), (32, F2, v - 2), (48, A2, v)]

def bass_bridge(v=42):
    return [
        (0, G2, v), (8, D3, v - 10), (12, Bb2, v - 8),
        (16, Bb2, v), (24, F2, v - 8), (28, D3, v - 10),
        (32, A2, v + 2), (40, E2, v - 8), (44, G2, v - 10),
        (48, A2, v), (56, E2, v - 8), (60, Cs3, v - 6),
    ]

def hook():
    return [
        (0, A4, 4), (4, D5, 6), (10, C5, 2), (12, A4, 4),
        (16, Bb4, 6), (22, A4, 2), (24, G4, 4), (28, A4, 4),
        (32, F4, 4), (36, G4, 4), (40, A4, 8),
        (48, E4, 4), (52, F4, 4), (56, G4, 4), (60, A4, 4),
    ]

def hook_b():
    return [
        (0, D5, 4), (4, F5, 4), (8, E5, 4), (12, D5, 4),
        (16, C5, 6), (22, Bb4, 2), (24, A4, 8),
        (32, C5, 4), (36, D5, 4), (40, F5, 6), (46, E5, 2),
        (48, D5, 4), (52, C5, 4), (56, Bb4, 4), (60, A4, 4),
    ]

def hook_thirds():
    return [
        (0, F4, 4), (4, A4, 6), (10, G4, 2), (12, F4, 4),
        (16, G4, 6), (22, F4, 2), (24, E4, 4), (28, F4, 4),
        (32, D4, 4), (36, E4, 4), (40, F4, 8),
        (48, Cs4, 4), (52, D4, 4), (56, E4, 4), (60, F4, 4),
    ]

def answer():
    return [
        (0, F5, 4), (4, E5, 2), (6, D5, 2), (8, C5, 6), (14, A4, 2),
        (16, Bb4, 4), (20, C5, 4), (24, D5, 8),
        (32, C5, 4), (36, Bb4, 4), (40, A4, 8),
        (48, G4, 4), (52, A4, 4), (56, F4, 8),
    ]

def ornament():
    return [
        (0, D5, 2), (2, E5, 2), (4, F5, 4), (8, E5, 2), (10, D5, 2), (12, C5, 4),
        (16, Bb4, 2), (18, C5, 2), (20, D5, 6), (28, A4, 4),
        (32, G4, 4), (36, A4, 4), (40, Bb4, 4), (44, A4, 4),
        (48, G4, 4), (52, F4, 4), (56, E4, 4), (60, D4, 4),
    ]

# arp figures stay inside one octave-plus, no random +12 jumps
ARP_DM = [D4, F4, A4, D5, A4, F4, E4, F4]
ARP_BB = [Bb3, D4, F4, Bb4, F4, D4, C4, D4]
ARP_F  = [F4, A4, C5, F5, C5, A4, G4, A4]
ARP_A  = [A3, Cs4, E4, A4, E4, Cs4, B3, Cs4]
ARP_GM = [G3, Bb3, D4, G4, D4, Bb3, A3, Bb3]
ARP_C  = [C4, E4, G4, C5, G4, E4, D4, E4]

def seq(*blocks):
    out = []
    for b in blocks:
        out.extend(b)
    return out

CHORD_MAIN = [
    (0, D4, A4, 28),
    (16, Bb3, F4, 26),
    (32, F3, C4, 26),
    (48, A3, E4, 30),
]
CHORD_COLOR = [
    (0, F4, D5, 24),
    (16, D4, Bb4, 24),
    (32, C4, A4, 24),
    (48, Cs4, A4, 28),
]

def make_patterns():
    P = []

    # 0 intro — wide pad, a bell hinting at the hook, one kick
    p = Pat(); 
    chords(p, [(0, D3, A3, 22), (16, Bb3, F4, 20), (32, F3, C4, 20), (48, A3, E4, 22)], inst=PAD)
    for row, m in ((0, A4), (8, D5), (16, F5), (24, D5), (32, C5), (40, A4), (48, E5), (56, Cs5)):
        p.n(6, row, m, BELL, 26)
    melody(p, [(32, A4, 12), (48, E5, 10)], vol=24, inst=SOFT, vibrato=True)
    drums(p, "pulse", kv=34)
    P.append(p)

    # 1 bass enters, half-time, arp states the progression
    p = Pat()
    chords(p, [(0, D3, A3, 18), (16, Bb3, F4, 16), (32, F3, C4, 16), (48, A3, E4, 18)], inst=PAD)
    drums(p, "half", kv=38, sv=26, hv=14)
    bass(p, bass_half(40))
    arp_line(p, seq(ARP_DM, ARP_BB, ARP_F, ARP_A), step=2, vol=22, inst=ARP)
    P.append(p)

    # 2 groove, stabs, arp, hook teaser in the last bar
    p = Pat()
    drums(p, "groove", kv=46, sv=34, hv=16)
    bass(p, bass_walking(44))
    arp_line(p, seq(ARP_DM, ARP_BB, ARP_F, ARP_A), step=2, vol=22, inst=ARP)
    chords(p, CHORD_MAIN)
    melody(p, [(48, A4, 4), (52, D5, 4), (56, C5, 4), (60, A4, 4)], vol=34, inst=LEAD)
    P.append(p)

    # 3 answer phrase over the same bed
    p = Pat()
    drums(p, "groove", kv=46, sv=34, hv=16)
    bass(p, bass_walking(44))
    arp_line(p, seq(ARP_DM, ARP_BB, ARP_C, ARP_A), step=2, vol=20, inst=ARP)
    chords(p, CHORD_COLOR)
    melody(p, answer(), vol=38, inst=LEAD)
    P.append(p)

    # 4 THE HOOK
    p = Pat()
    drums(p, "drive", kv=48, sv=36, hv=16)
    bass(p, bass_push(46))
    arp_line(p, seq(ARP_DM, ARP_BB, ARP_F, ARP_A), step=2, vol=18, inst=BELL)
    chords(p, CHORD_MAIN)
    melody(p, hook(), vol=42, inst=LEAD)
    P.append(p)

    # 5 hook B
    p = Pat()
    drums(p, "drive", kv=48, sv=36, hv=16)
    bass(p, bass_push(46))
    arp_line(p, seq(ARP_DM, ARP_BB, ARP_GM, ARP_A), step=2, vol=20, inst=ARP)
    chords(p, CHORD_COLOR)
    melody(p, hook_b(), vol=42, inst=LEAD)
    P.append(p)

    # 6 breakdown — pad, long notes, bells, half drums
    p = Pat()
    chords(p, [(0, D3, A3, 24), (16, Bb3, F4, 22), (32, C4, G4, 22), (48, A3, E4, 24)], inst=PAD)
    drums(p, "half", kv=32, sv=22, hv=12)
    bass(p, bass_half(36))
    for row, m in ((0, D5), (8, A4), (16, F5), (24, D5), (32, C5), (40, G4), (48, E5), (56, Cs5)):
        p.n(6, row, m, BELL, 30)
    melody(p, [(0, A4, 16), (16, Bb4, 14), (32, G4, 14), (48, A4, 16)], vol=32, inst=SOFT)
    P.append(p)

    # 7 hook in harmony (thirds under, lead on top) — the peak statement
    p = Pat()
    drums(p, "drive", kv=48, sv=36, hv=15)
    bass(p, bass_push(48))
    chords(p, CHORD_MAIN)
    melody(p, hook_thirds(), vol=28, inst=SOFT, ch=6)
    melody(p, hook(), vol=44, inst=LEAD, ch=7)
    P.append(p)

    # 8 ornament over the arp
    p = Pat()
    drums(p, "drive", kv=46, sv=36, hv=15)
    bass(p, bass_push(46))
    arp_line(p, seq(ARP_DM, ARP_BB, ARP_C, ARP_A), step=2, vol=20, inst=ARP)
    chords(p, CHORD_COLOR)
    melody(p, ornament(), vol=40, inst=LEAD)
    P.append(p)

    # 9 bridge: Gm colour, then the dominant
    p = Pat()
    drums(p, "groove", kv=44, sv=34, hv=15)
    bass(p, bass_bridge(42))
    arp_line(p, seq(ARP_GM, ARP_BB, ARP_F, ARP_A), step=2, vol=22, inst=ARP)
    chords(p, [(0, G3, D4, 26), (16, Bb3, F4, 26), (32, F3, C4, 24), (48, Cs4, A4, 30)])
    melody(p, [
        (0, G4, 4), (4, Bb4, 4), (8, D5, 8),
        (16, C5, 4), (20, Bb4, 4), (24, A4, 8),
        (32, A4, 4), (36, C5, 4), (40, E5, 8),
        (48, D5, 4), (52, C5, 4), (56, Bb4, 4), (60, A4, 4),
    ], vol=38, inst=SOFT)
    P.append(p)

    # 10 final chorus: harmony + hook B, a little louder
    p = Pat()
    drums(p, "drive", kv=50, sv=38, hv=15)
    bass(p, bass_push(48))
    chords(p, [(0, D4, A4, 30), (16, Bb3, F4, 28), (32, C4, G4, 28), (48, Cs4, A4, 32)])
    melody(p, hook_thirds(), vol=28, inst=SOFT, ch=6)
    melody(p, hook_b(), vol=44, inst=LEAD, ch=7)
    P.append(p)

    # 11 climb / fill into the drop
    p = Pat()
    drums(p, "break", kv=46, sv=36, hv=14)
    bass(p, bass_bridge(44))
    arp_line(p, seq(ARP_GM, ARP_BB, ARP_A, ARP_A), step=2, vol=22, inst=BELL)
    chords(p, [(0, G3, D4, 26), (16, Bb3, F4, 26), (32, A3, E4, 30), (48, Cs4, G4, 28)])
    melody(p, [
        (0, D4, 4), (4, F4, 4), (8, A4, 4), (12, C5, 4),
        (16, D5, 4), (20, F5, 4), (24, E5, 8),
        (32, D5, 4), (36, C5, 4), (40, Bb4, 4), (44, A4, 4),
        (48, G4, 2), (50, A4, 2), (52, Bb4, 2), (54, C5, 2), (56, D5, 8),
    ], vol=40, inst=LEAD)
    P.append(p)

    # 12 drop — space, the hook slowed to half
    p = Pat()
    chords(p, [(0, D3, A3, 24), (16, Bb3, F4, 22), (32, F3, C4, 22), (48, A3, E4, 24)], inst=PAD)
    for r, v in ((0, 40), (16, 34), (32, 38), (48, 42)):
        p.n(0, r, C3, KICK, v)
    p.n(1, 8, D3, SNARE, 20)
    p.n(1, 40, D3, SNARE, 18)
    for r in (0, 16, 32, 48):
        p.n(2, r, C5, HAT, 12)
    bass(p, bass_half(38))
    for row, m in ((0, D5), (16, F5), (32, C5), (48, E5)):
        p.n(6, row, m, BELL, 28)
    melody(p, [(0, D5, 16), (16, F5, 14), (32, C5, 16), (48, A4, 16)], vol=36, inst=LEAD)
    P.append(p)

    # 13 the hook returns, plain and bright
    p = Pat()
    drums(p, "drive", kv=48, sv=36, hv=16)
    bass(p, bass_walking(46))
    arp_line(p, seq(ARP_DM, ARP_BB, ARP_F, ARP_A), step=2, vol=22, inst=ARP)
    chords(p, CHORD_MAIN)
    melody(p, hook(), vol=42, inst=LEAD)
    P.append(p)

    # 14 last chorus with the harmony
    p = Pat()
    drums(p, "drive", kv=50, sv=38, hv=15)
    bass(p, bass_push(48))
    chords(p, CHORD_MAIN)
    melody(p, hook_thirds(), vol=28, inst=SOFT, ch=6)
    melody(p, hook(), vol=46, inst=LEAD, ch=7)
    P.append(p)

    # 15 outro: descend to D, last bar is the dominant so the loop resolves onto intro's Dm
    p = Pat()
    drums(p, "half", kv=28, sv=18, hv=10)
    bass(p, [(0, D2, 36), (16, F2, 32), (32, D2, 34), (48, A2, 36)])
    chords(p, [(0, D3, A3, 20), (16, F3, C4, 18), (32, D3, A3, 18), (48, A3, E4, 20)], inst=PAD)
    melody(p, [(0, A4, 8), (8, G4, 8), (16, F4, 8), (24, E4, 8), (32, D4, 14)], vol=30, inst=SOFT)
    p.n(6, 0, A4, BELL, 24)
    p.n(6, 32, D5, BELL, 22)
    p.n(6, 48, E5, BELL, 22)
    p.n(6, 56, Cs5, BELL, 18)
    p.off(7, 48)
    p.off(4, 62)
    p.off(5, 62)
    p.off(3, 62)
    p.off(6, 62)
    P.append(p)
    return P

def build():
    samples = [
        (1, kick(), "kick", False, 64, "Kick"),
        (2, snare(), "snare", False, 50, "Snare"),
        (3, hat(False), "hat", False, 32, "Hat"),
        (4, hat(True), "ohat", False, 30, "HatOpen"),
        (5, bass_loop(), "bass", True, 64, "Bass"),
        (6, lead_loop(), "lead", True, 46, "Lead"),
        (7, lead_soft(), "lead2", True, 40, "LeadSoft"),
        (8, pad_loop(), "pad", True, 40, "Pad"),
        (9, bell(), "bell", False, 40, "Bell"),
        (10, stab(), "stab", False, 38, "Stab"),
        (11, arp(), "arp", False, 38, "Arp"),
    ]
    pats = make_patterns()
    print(f"{len(pats)} patterns")
    for i, p in enumerate(pats):
        print(f"  {i:02d} {len(p.cells):3d} cells")

    calls = [
        {"name": "module_new", "arguments": {"channels": 8, "name": "Serial Velocity"}},
        {"name": "song_set", "arguments": {
            "name": "Serial Velocity", "bpm": 132, "speed": 5,
            "length": len(pats), "loop_start": 0, "channels": 8,
        }},
    ]
    for inst, pcm, sname, loop, vol, iname in samples:
        calls.append({"name": "sample_create_from_pcm", "arguments": {
            "instrument": inst, "sample": 0, "pcm": b64(pcm),
            "encoding": "float32", "name": sname}})

import wave, numpy as np
w=wave.open("/tmp/tune_preview.wav")
d=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype=np.int16).reshape(-1,2).astype(np.float32)
sr=w.getframerate(); mono=d.mean(1)
row_s=5*2.5/132; pat_s=64*row_s

def top(t0, dur, fmax=4000, n=6):
    seg=mono[int(t0*sr):int((t0+dur)*sr)]
    seg=(seg-seg.mean())*np.hanning(len(seg))
    spec=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg)); freqs=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(seg),1/sr)
    spec[freqs>fmax]=0
    idx=np.argsort(spec)[-n:][::-1]
    return [(round(float(freqs[i]),1), int(spec[i])) for i in idx]

print("P0 pad", top(0.4, 0.7, 2000))
print("P0 bell", top(0.02, 0.25, 2500))
print("P4 A4+stab", top(4*pat_s+0.04, 0.22, 2500))
print("P4 D5", top(4*pat_s+4*row_s+0.05, 0.25, 2500))
print("P2 arp start", top(2*pat_s+0.02, 0.15, 2500))
print("P7 harmony", top(7*pat_s+0.05, 0.22, 2500))
print("P6 long lead", top(6*pat_s+0.3, 0.5, 2000))

# per-bar contour of the hook pattern vs a dull one
print("bar energy")
for pi in (0,2,4,6,7,12,15):
    s0=int(pi*pat_s*sr)
    bars=[]
    for b in range(4):
        s=s0+int(b*16*row_s*sr); e=s+int(16*row_s*sr)
        bars.append(int(np.sqrt(np.mean(mono[s:e]**2))))
    print(pi, bars)

# stereo of a stab moment vs pad moment
def lr(t, dur):
    s=int(t*sr); e=int((t+dur)*sr)
    return (int(np.sqrt(np.mean(d[s:e,0]**2))), int(np.sqrt(np.mean(d[s:e,1]**2))),
            round(float(np.corrcoef(d[s:e,0], d[s:e,1])[0,1]), 2))
print("p0 pad+bell", lr(0.3, 0.6))
print("p2 stab", lr(2*pat_s+0.02, 0.2))
print("p4 lead side", lr(4*pat_s+4*row_s+0.05, 0.3))
print("p6", lr(6*pat_s+0.3, 0.5))

import wave, numpy as np
w=wave.open("/tmp/tune_preview.wav")
d=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype=np.int16).reshape(-1,2).astype(np.float32)
sr=w.getframerate(); mono=d.mean(1)
row_s=5*2.5/132; pat_s=64*row_s
print("peak", float(np.max(np.abs(d))), "clips", int(np.sum(np.max(np.abs(d),1)>30000)), "dur", round(len(d)/sr,1))
def bands(sig):
    spec=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(sig*np.hanning(len(sig))))
    freqs=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(sig),1/sr)
    def b(a,c): return spec[(freqs>=a)&(freqs<c)].sum()
    parts=[b(30,100),b(100,400),b(400,1800),b(1800,5000),b(5000,11000)]
    t=sum(parts)+1
    return [round(float(x/t),2) for x in parts]
for i in [0,2,4,6,7,10,12,15]:
    s=int(i*pat_s*sr); e=int((i+1)*pat_s*sr)
    ch=d[s:e]
    rms=np.sqrt(np.mean(ch**2)); pk=np.max(np.abs(ch))
    side=(ch[:,0]-ch[:,1])/2; mid=ch.mean(1)
    wdt=np.sqrt(np.mean(side**2))/(np.sqrt(np.mean(mid**2))+1e-9)
    print(f"p{i:02d} rms {rms:5.0f} pk {pk:5.0f} w {wdt:.2f} {bands(mono[s:e])}")

def fund(t0,dur,lo,hi):
    seg=mono[int(t0*sr):int((t0+dur)*sr)]
    seg=(seg-seg.mean())*np.hanning(len(seg))
    spec=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg)); freqs=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(seg),1/sr)
    spec[(freqs<lo)|(freqs>hi)]=0
    k=np.argmax(spec)
    return round(float(freqs[k]),1), int(spec[k])
print("bass", fund(2*pat_s+0.12,0.3,30,200))
print("leadA expect 440", fund(4*pat_s+0.08,0.25,80,900))
print("leadD expect 587", fund(4*pat_s+4*row_s+0.08,0.28,80,1200))
print("pad expect 146/220", fund(0.5,0.6,60,500))
print("bell intro expect 880 (A5) or 440", fund(0.05,0.3,200,2000))
print("start/end", float(np.sqrt(np.mean(mono[:int(0.2*sr)]**2))), float(np.sqrt(np.mean(mono[-int(0.2*sr):]**2))))

# stab stereo after the click dies
t=2*pat_s+0.12
s=int(t*sr); e=int((t+0.25)*sr)
print("stab sustain L/R/corr", int(np.sqrt(np.mean(d[s:e,0]**2))), int(np.sqrt(np.mean(d[s:e,1]**2))),
      round(float(np.corrcoef(d[s:e,0],d[s:e,1])[0,1]),2))
t=4*pat_s+4*row_s+0.1
s=int(t*sr); e=int((t+0.3)*sr)
print("lead D5 window L/R/corr", int(np.sqrt(np.mean(d[s:e,0]**2))), int(np.sqrt(np.mean(d[s:e,1]**2))),
      round(float(np.corrcoef(d[s:e,0],d[s:e,1])[0,1]),2))

from pathlib import Path
p = Path("/workspace/compose.py")
s = p.read_text()
# 1. pan on every note again (effect sticks; first note of a pattern also carries it)

'''    def n(self, ch, row, midi, inst, vol=40):
        if inst in LOW_INST:
            midi += 12
        self.put(ch, row, note=nn(midi), inst=inst, vol=vol)
''',
'''    def n(self, ch, row, midi, inst, vol=40):
        if inst in LOW_INST:
            midi += 12
        self.put(ch, row, note=nn(midi), inst=inst, vol=vol, fx=8, fp=PAN[ch])
''')
# 2. remove vol-slide and vibrato that fight the melody
s = s.replace(
'''def melody(p, phrase, vol=40, inst=LEAD, ch=7, vibrato=True):
    ons = []
    for row, midi, length in phrase:
        p.n(ch, row, midi, inst, vol)
        ons.append((row, length))
        if vibrato and length >= 8 and row + 4 < p.rows:
            p.vib(ch, row + 4, 3, 3)
        if length >= 8:
            fr = row + length - 2
            if 0 <= fr < p.rows:
                p.slide(ch, fr, 0x02)
    for i, (row, length) in enumerate(ons):
        end = row + length
        nxt = ons[i + 1][0] if i + 1 < len(ons) else 10_000
        if end < p.rows and end < nxt:
            p.off(ch, end)
''',
'''def melody(p, phrase, vol=40, inst=LEAD, ch=7, vibrato=True):
    ons = []
    for row, midi, length in phrase:
        p.n(ch, row, midi, inst, vol)
        ons.append((row, length))
        if vibrato and length >= 10 and row + 6 < p.rows:
            p.vib(ch, row + 6, 2, 2)
    for i, (row, length) in enumerate(ons):
        end = row + length
        nxt = ons[i + 1][0] if i + 1 < len(ons) else 10_000
        if end < p.rows and nxt - end >= 2:
            p.off(ch, end)
''')

# stab a touch darker
s = s.replace("x = lop(np.tanh(0.85 * x), 0.34)", "x = lop(np.tanh(0.85 * x), 0.26)")

{"command":"python3 << 'PY'
import wave, numpy as np
w=wave.open("/tmp/tune_preview.wav")
d=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype=np.int16).reshape(-1,2).astype(np.float32)
sr=w.getframerate(); mono=d.mean(1)
row_s=5*2.5/132; pat_s=64*row_s
print("peak", float(np.max(np.abs(d))), "clips", int(np.sum(np.max(np.abs(d),1)>29000)), "dur", round(len(d)/sr,1))
def bands(sig):
    spec=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(sig*np.hanning(len(sig))))
    freqs=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(sig),1/sr)
    def b(a,c): return spec[(freqs>=a)&(freqs<c)].sum()
    parts=[b(30,120),b(120,500),b(500,2000),b(2000,6000),b(6000,11000)]
    t=sum(parts)+1
    return [round(float(x/t),2) for x in parts]
for i in range(16):
    s=int(i*pat_s*sr); e=int(min(len(d),(i+1)*pat_s*sr))
    ch=d[s:e]
    rms=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(ch**2)))
    side=(ch[:,0]-ch[:,1])/2; mid=ch.mean(1)
    wdt=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(side**2))/(np.sqrt(np.mean(mid**2))+1e-9))
    print(f"p{i:02d} rms {rms:5.0f} pk {np.max(np.abs(ch)):5.0f} w {wdt:.2f} {bands(mono[s:e])}")
print("start/end", float(np.sqrt(np.mean(mono[:int(0.2*sr)]**2))), float(np.sqrt(np.mean(mono[-int(0.25*sr):]**2))))
# pitch
def fund(t0,dur,lo,hi):
    seg=mono[int(t0*sr):int((t0+dur)*sr)]
    seg=(seg-seg.mean())*np.hanning(len(seg))
    spec=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg)); freqs=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(seg),1/sr)
    spec[(freqs<lo)|(freqs>hi)]=0
    return round(float(freqs[np.argmax(spec)]),1)
print("bass", fund(2*pat_s+0.1,0.3,30,200), "A", fund(4*pat_s+0.08,0.22,200,900),
      "D", fund(4*pat_s+4*row_s+0.08,0.25,300,1200))
